comment: Pinned official Piper builds (https://github.com/rhasspy/piper/releases, MIT; the last standalone binary, the repository is archived), D127. GitHub has no digest for these 2023 assets: the SHA-256 values were computed from the downloads on 2026-11-25. Voices must come from a piper-voices revision written for this binary (before 2026-11-17, e.g. a60bfb135881): newer voice configs use phonemes it cannot read.
